attention_gate.target_definition: official Space ticker with at least one attention-only event seed and at least one official non-attention event seed

single_event_gate.target_definition: official Space ticker with exactly one official non-attention seed, government_space_contract present, no customer_win, and defense_budget_theme

government_contract_gate.target_definition: official Space ticker with government_space_contract from an official non-attention source

multi_event_gate.target_definition: official Space ticker with at least two official, non-attention event seed rows

defense_budget_same_theme_winner_gate.target_definition: official Space ticker with a mature defense_budget_theme government_space_contract row whose 10d cash-relative PnL, same-theme replacement value, and direct event return are positive

hypothesis: Within source-diverse dual-catalyst Space trend signals, closed forward rows that show multi-event, all-benchmark positive consistency should represent higher-quality catalyst continuation than average-only replacement strength; a small risk scalar could improve EV without changing the candidate pool or production/LLM boundaries.

experiment_log_record.hypothesis: Within source-diverse dual-catalyst Space trend signals, closed forward rows that show multi-event, all-benchmark positive consistency should represent higher-quality catalyst continuation than average-only replacement strength; a small risk scalar could improve EV without changing the candidate pool or production/LLM boundaries.
experiment_log_record.backtest_protocol: docs/backtesting.md fixed 3-window Space protocol using frozen Space augmented snapshots

gate_answers.1_alpha_hypothesis: Within source-diverse dual-catalyst Space trend signals, closed forward rows that show multi-event, all-benchmark positive consistency should represent higher-quality catalyst continuation than average-only replacement strength; a small risk scalar could improve EV without changing the candidate pool or production/LLM boundaries.
2_prior_similar_experiments: exp-20260514-047 accepted benchmark breadth plus same-theme strength on an older stack.
exp-20260519-027 accepted the final dual-catalyst benchmark-breadth precision scalar; nearby scalar mining needs a different field.
exp-20260521-017 rejected a mature same-theme replacement pool change; this run keeps the pool fixed and tests row-level multi-event consistency.
gate_answers.3_single_causal_variable: Only one Space capital-allocation variable changes: an extra forward-consistency scalar. Pool, entry, exit, ranking, LLM/news, event profiles, benchmark-breadth scalar, and live slots remain fixed.
gate_answers.4_success_criteria: Aggregate EV delta must exceed 10% of current Space aggregate EV, aggregate PnL must improve, at least two windows must improve, no window may regress, drawdown drift <= 0.5 pp, survival >= 5%, trade count >= 50, fields complete, and adjusted cohort spans at least two tickers and two windows.

experiment_log_record.rejection_reason: Gate 4 failed: no forward-consistency scalar cleared the strict 10% EV, multi-window, no-regression, cohort breadth, drawdown, survival, and trade-count acceptance gates.
experiment_log_record.next_evidence_needed: Do not promote this forward-consistency scalar from the current sample. Revisit only after new closed Space forward rows broaden the multi-event consistency cohort beyond its current support.

production_impact.notes: Experiment-only wrapper; no live policy promoted.

experiment_log_record.why_not_other_changes: LLM soft-ranking is still underpowered; noisy ticker expansion would violate candidate-governance guidance; and the recent accepted/rejected Space work already mined adjacent benchmark-breadth and pool variants. This run tests a different production-visible forward-quality field.
